title: UPDATE: Ant Group Ming-3.0-tts Hits #1 Open Weights Rank in Voice Benchmarks
summary:
The 0.5B parameter voice model scored 93.2% on the Pronunciation Robustness leaderboard to surpass rival tools from Eleven and Fish Audio, according to data from Artificial Analysis. Ming-3.0-tts also ranks as the top open weights model in the Controlled Voice Arena with an Elo of 1,069, beating Drama 3 Preview and Breeze TTS 2. The model maintains the top open weights spot for both US and UK English and ranks 13th overall across all tested entries.

This performance follows Ant Group's release of a five-model Ming-3.0 suite spanning text-to-speech, audio understanding, and automatic speech recognition. The collection includes an 8.6B parameter model for dialects and a 126B parameter model for audio tools, all available under the MIT License via Hugging Face and ModelScope. vLLM-Omni provides immediate support to serve the models' weights.

selectedTweets.text:
Ant Group's Ming-3.0-tts is the new #1 open weights model in the Artificial Analysis Controlled Voice TTS Arena and takes the #1 spot on our Pronunciation Robustness leaderboard, level with Fish Audio's Drama 3 Preview and ahead of Eleven v4

Ming-3.0-tts is the new open weights Text to Speech model from @AntGroup team, a dense 0.5B parameter model with preset voices and stateless voice cloning. Weights are available on Hugging Face under the MIT License: Ming-3.0-tts-0.5B, alongside a 7.9B mixture-of-experts variant, Ming-3.0-tts-tiny.

Key takeaways:

➤ Pronunciation Robustness: Ming-3.0-tts scores 93.2%, ranking #1 of 31 models, level with Fish Audio Drama 3 Preview at 93.2% and ahead of Eleven v4 at 91.7%. It ranks #1 in Expanding Shorthand and Preserving Exact Sequences.

➤ Controlled Voice: Ming-3.0-tts is the #1 open weights model with an Elo of 1,069 (+16/-16) across 1,827 appearances, ahead of Drama 3 Preview at 1,059 and Breeze TTS 2 at 1,019. It ranks #13 overall.

➤ Provider Voice: Ming-3.0-tts has an Elo of 1,188 (+15/-15) across 1,957 appearances, ranking #3 among open weights models behind Drama 3 Preview at 1,245 and Breeze TTS 2 at 1,220, and #19 overall.

➤ Open weights: Ming-3.0-tts is the #1 open weights model on two of our three Text to Speech leaderboards, Controlled Voice and Pronunciation Robustness, and #3 on Provider Voice.
